title: Hands and Hooves
summary: Your people learn to work: crafting tools, paving roads between their homes, and winning the trust of wild beasts.
briefing: A people with tools outlives a people with only hands.
Watch them craft, pave and tame. Their day now bends to the age they live in.
Roads cancel the drag of ruined ground — build them where the soil has died.

quests.title: Arm the working hand
quests.description: Your people craft tools once they have the resources and the age for it.

quests.title: Bind the settlements
quests.description: Roads join structures and speed every journey between them.

quests.title: Beasts at heel
quests.description: Some animals will follow those who approach them patiently.
